articles.title: U.S. President names CFTC, SEC nominees for first time in a year
articles.snippet: U.S. President Donald Trump has named two potential commissioners each to the Securities and Exchange Commission and Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

articles.title: Nomura weighs Laser Digital sale as European losses hit four straight quarters
articles.snippet: The Japanese brokerage has held talks with potential buyers, including Marex, as its European business posts more losses.

articles.title: Nomura explores sale of crypto unit Laser Digital: Bloomberg
articles.snippet: The potential sale of Laser Digital follows a fourth straight quarterly loss for Nomura’s European operations.

articles.title: Bitcoin Miner HIVE Eyes $45 Million in Annual Revenue From AI Deal
articles.snippet: The Bitcoin miner says its Boden facility could generate $45 million annually, but a June letter of intent remains nonbinding as executives negotiate financing and customer protections for the project.

articles.title: Near AI Breach Exposes User Details and Data From 18 AI Agents
articles.snippet: An SGLang flaw let an attacker reach internal systems and potentially view confidential AI requests, exposing the limits of hardware-backed privacy protections.
